verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based coding agent, so cloud background delegation is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only shows local headless runs, embedding in your own CI scripts or servers, and cross-turn goals. It never documents a first-party isolated cloud environment for background tasks, and running headless inside a user's own CI is a user-side or host-platform workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
